title: Red apple with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='appleGlow' cx='38%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7a7a'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#e8322f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b81a22'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stemGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a0672e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6e4218'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='leafGrad' cx='30%' cy='30%' r='80%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8ce85a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2f9e2a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- apple body: two lobes with a dip on top -->
  <path d='M50 22
           C40 14, 20 16, 16 34
           C12 52, 20 76, 34 86
           C42 91, 47 88, 50 86
           C53 88, 58 91, 66 86
           C80 76, 88 52, 84 34
           C80 16, 60 14, 50 22 Z'
        fill='url(#appleGlow)'/>

  <!-- lighter highlight sheen on upper left -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='38' rx='11' ry='15' fill='#ff9c9c' opacity='0.55'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='31' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffd0d0' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- dip shading at top to show the cleft -->
  <path d='M38 24 C43 20, 50 22, 50 30 C50 22, 57 20, 62 24 C56 27, 44 27, 38 24 Z'
        fill='#a3161f' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 22 C49 16, 51 10, 54 6' stroke='url(#stemGrad)' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M54 12 C62 4, 76 6, 78 12 C72 18, 60 18, 54 12 Z' fill='url(#leafGrad)'/>
  <path d='M56 12 C64 11, 72 11, 77 12' stroke='#1f7a1c' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- smiling face -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='52' rx='4.5' ry='6' fill='#3a0a10'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='52' rx='4.5' ry='6' fill='#3a0a10'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='49.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffd7d7'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='49.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffd7d7'/>

  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='63' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff5a5a' opacity='0.55'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='63' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff5a5a' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M37 64 Q50 78 63 64' stroke='#3a0a10' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
